title: plan/storyboard.json — visuals per scene (types = template scene components)

sfx.description: sound for this boundary; null silences it

focus.description: through: screen point [x, y] (0–1) to dive at; default the outgoing subject from its depth map

sound.description: library id or category (onevideo lib list), a procedural sound (whoosh, tick, impact, riser, pop, chime), or synth:<name> to force the procedural one

enter.description: transition into this scene; wins over the previous scene's exit

backdrop.description: Full-bleed photo or footage behind the scene (charts sit on frosted cards above it).

shots.description: camera shot track over the whole scene (content + overlays): "auto" = one framing per caption line alternating moves and cuts, or a list of shots

overlay.description: motion graphic layered over the scene at a cue; x/y/from/to/rect are fractions of the frame, size is in layout units (px at 1080)

duration.description: seconds on screen; default until the scene ends

sfx.description: sound at the overlay's cue: library id/category, "auto" (by overlay type), or null for none

src.description: lottie: library id or category (onevideo lib list --kind lottie) or a .json under public/

tint.description: lottie: recolour every static fill/stroke (black line icons are tinted to the theme text colour automatically)

on.description: pin to a scene element instead of x/y/rect, so it follows the content in any aspect: stat-cards card1…/a card cue, compare left/right/left-value/right-value, share ring/seg1…/a segment cue, bar-compare bar1…/an item cue, bar-race bar1…/rank1…/period, line-chart point1…/last/s2-point1…/note1…/an annotation cue, canvas an item id

place.description: where on the `on` element (default: top-right for stamp/icon/lottie/image/callout, centre otherwise)

offset.description: [dx, dy] in layout units from the `place` point, for a sticker beside a small element (a chart point) instead of on it

scrim.description: word: backing strength for legibility; set over media automatically, 0 = none

when.description: like `at`, plus {beat: n} = the nth music beat counted from the scene start

shot.description: one framing on the scene's shot track; cut = jump on this frame, else travel in `ease` s

focus.description: [x, y, w, h] region (frame fractions) to frame

snap.description: false = do not snap to a beat

cue.description: name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves
name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves

periodCues.description: cue name per period (null = auto); the race reaches period k when its cue resolves

cue.description: name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves

drawCue.description: name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves

pointCues.description: cue name per point (null = auto); the line reaches point k when its cue resolves

cue.description: name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves

total.description: a headline row above the legend with the sum of all segments

cue.description: name of a cue in scene.cues; the row appears when it resolves (default: with the ring)
name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves
name of a cue in scene.cues; the item appears when it resolves

snap.description: false: keep this exact time instead of snapping to the music

ramp.description: speed ramp: from each point the clip plays at `speed` (blended over 0.3 s)

behind.description: put the title behind the subject (needs onevideo depth on the asset)

matte.description: which pixels count as the subject: subject = nearer than surroundings (thin subjects: a rocket, a tower), near = depth above threshold, default the frame's own near/far split (a person filling the frame)

duration.description: seconds on screen, then a 0.3 s fade

screen.description: real UI pinned to a dark screen in the footage: four corners TL, TR, BR, BL in 0–1 of the frame (onevideo screen <asset> finds them); static device only

steps.description: the UI moving on the inserted screen: switch to another capture (asset) or scroll a tall one (scroll 0 top … 1 bottom)

blend.description: screen (default) keeps the glass's reflections; normal covers them

occlude.description: what stays in front of the screen (a finger): a mask asset (white = in front) or the depth matte

matte.description: which pixels count as the subject: subject = nearer than surroundings (thin subjects: a rocket, a tower), near = depth above threshold, default the frame's own near/far split (a person filling the frame)

windows.description: a second picture revealed through vertical windows opening behind the subject (needs onevideo depth on the footage)

matte.description: which pixels count as the subject: subject = nearer than surroundings (thin subjects: a rocket, a tower), near = depth above threshold, default the frame's own near/far split (a person filling the frame)

behind.description: put the title behind the subject (needs onevideo depth on the asset)

matte.description: which pixels count as the subject: subject = nearer than surroundings (thin subjects: a rocket, a tower), near = depth above threshold, default the frame's own near/far split (a person filling the frame)

duration.description: seconds on screen, then a 0.3 s fade

inherit.description: continue the previous canvas scene's world and camera

floor.description: dot-lattice floor that moves with the camera (default: on unless the scene has a backdrop)

items.description: world item; x/y = centre, w/h = size, in layout units (1u = 1px at 1080 short edge; the first screen spans 0–1920 × 0–1080 in 16:9)
camera stop: frame item id(s) or a point; fly = travel seconds

snap.description: false: keep this exact time instead of snapping to the music

device.description: default: phone in portrait, browser in landscape

screen.description: switch to this screen (index or id)

scroll.description: scroll a tall capture: 0 top, 1 bottom

tap.description: [x, y] in 0–1 of the screen, or a rect name (its centre)

expand.description: a card grows out of `rect` (default: around the tap) to `to` (default: centred, as large as fits)

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in 0–1 of the screen, or a rect name from onevideo capture --rects

to.description: [x, y, w, h] in 0–1 of the screen, or a rect name from onevideo capture --rects

asset.description: what the open card shows (default: that part of the screen, enlarged)

collapse.description: fold the open card back into its place

camera.description: framing override; default: page on a tap, result on an expand, device on a collapse

focus.description: [x, y, w, h] in 0–1 of the screen, or a rect name from onevideo capture --rects

every.description: seconds per still, or beat / bar to cut on the music

size.description: still size as a share of the short edge (default 0.62)

title.description: closing title over the last still
